note: The script asks for two graphics: the question on top and the Mackinnon name super. The proof shot is a screen recording, not a graphic. Then the watsi.org end card.

mg.title: Question on top

text.main: How do we know care actually happens?

mg.cue: Question on top from frame 1, top third: How do we know care actually happens?

mg.title: Name super
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05.5 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Make it large. First name only.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: watsi.org, all lowercase, Lato, navy #2E2844. Nothing else.
